# Tugg

> Tugg is a global pay-to-pull rivalry game: visitors buy one-time bundles of 5, 10 or 25 pulls at $1 per pull ($5, $10 or $25, in whole US dollars) to pull a virtual rope toward their side of a matchup such as Pizza vs Burgers. Each matchup runs in rounds that last one calendar week (ending Monday 00:00 UTC) or, for busy matchups, one day (ending 00:00 UTC); the side with more money when its round closes wins bragging rights. Each side's all-time total and round wins never reset. It is paid entertainment only: there are no prizes, payouts or winnings.

All numbers on Tugg come from real, confirmed payments. Rounds that receive no pulls have no winner. Matchups are created by Tugg or by players ($9 standard, $29 featured for 7 days) and are checked by moderation; rejected matchups are refunded automatically. Payments are processed by Dodo Payments as merchant of record.

Every matchup and rivalry page starts with a short, dated factual summary (UTC) of the current round, the previous round's result and the all-time score that can be quoted directly. Each page states its own round length.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tugg.lol/): Live matchups with current round rope positions.
- [How it works](https://tugg.lol/how-it-works): Pulls, weekly and daily rounds, tie-breaks and the all-time score.
- [Leaderboards](https://tugg.lol/leaderboards): Biggest ropes ever, longest win streaks, most pulled live rounds, top countries.
- [Hall of Fame](https://tugg.lol/hall-of-fame): Every past round winner with result cards.
- [Yesterday on Tugg](https://tugg.lol/recap): Dated recap published for each UTC day with pulls or a round that closed with pulls (whatever the round length), built from stored facts: that day's pulls and any rounds that closed. Quiet days get no recap; archive at /recap/YYYY-MM-DD.
- [Stats](https://tugg.lol/stats): Site-wide totals.
- [Example matchup](https://tugg.lol/m/pizza-vs-burgers): Live round, rope, all-time score, history and countries for one matchup.
- [Example rivalry](https://tugg.lol/rivalries/pizza-vs-burgers): "Who is winning?" page with live result, history and FAQ.
- [FAQ](https://tugg.lol/faq): Straight answers about pulls, rounds, payments and refunds.
- [Rules](https://tugg.lol/rules): What is and isn't allowed.

## Public feeds

- [Matchups (JSON)](https://tugg.lol/feeds/matchups.json): Every live matchup with current round totals, round length and all-time score.
- [Matchups (RSS)](https://tugg.lol/feeds/matchups.rss): New matchups.
- [Round results (JSON)](https://tugg.lol/feeds/results.json): Winners and final totals of each closed round.
- [Round results (RSS)](https://tugg.lol/feeds/results.rss): Round winners as they are crowned.
- [Leaderboard (JSON)](https://tugg.lol/feeds/leaderboard.json): Biggest ropes, streaks, most pulled live rounds, top countries.
- [Leaderboard (RSS)](https://tugg.lol/feeds/leaderboard.rss): Biggest ropes ever.
- [Sitemap](https://tugg.lol/sitemap.xml): All public pages.

## Optional

- [Terms](https://tugg.lol/terms): Plain-English terms of use.
- [Refund policy](https://tugg.lol/refund-policy): Pulls are non-refundable; rejected matchups are refunded automatically.
- [Privacy](https://tugg.lol/privacy): What Tugg stores.
- [About / Legal](https://tugg.lol/about-legal): Business name and contact.
